title: Typing a timecode works and talks back
why: Click the timecode or Ctrl+G, type 5108 Enter, and I'm at 51:08. Nonsense gets a plain answer ('"abc" is not a timecode — try 40. or 1:05 or 00:00:40:00 or +2.', 'frames go 0–23 at 24 fps', 'before the start, went to the first frame'). That's better than Premiere's silent reject.

title: Copy / cut / paste of shots exists, is in the Edit menu, and tells you where it landed
why: Ctrl+C toast 'copied 1 shot — Ctrl+V inserts it at the playhead'; paste toast names the timecode and the shot it split; one Ctrl+Z takes a paste back ('undone: paste a shot'); Ctrl+X then End, Ctrl+V moved a shot to the end in two keys.

title: Transitions by hand mostly work like Premiere
why: Ctrl+Shift+D at Home now gives 'fading the film in', at End 'fading the film out' (last frame black); Sequence › Apply default transition (Ctrl+D) puts a centred 1 s dissolve on the cut at the playhead with a toast; dragging an end shortens it with a live '0.33 s · 8 frames' readout.

title: Delete always says what went
why: 'removed shot 2 · GX010475 (3.7 s) — Ctrl+Z brings it back' even when the shot was scrolled off screen (the timeline scrolls to show the hole); on an edit point: 'nothing to delete at this edit — select a shot to remove it'.

title: Transport buttons hold still
why: Play becomes Pause in the same 74 px button; Source and Program rows measured identical playing, stopped and with readouts on.

title: Editing into an empty sequence just works
why: After emptying a copy, the empty Timeline and Program both say 'drag a clip here or press , (Insert)'; ',' put the Source In–Out at 0:00 with a toast.

title: Rotate clip and Fill the frame do what they say
why: Right-click a clip › Rotate clip › 90° right turned the Source picture to portrait within seconds with a toast that has its own Undo; Rotation 90 in Effect Controls brings up 'Fill the frame', which set Scale 177.8 and filled the 16:9 frame in one click (undo: scale).

title: Undo and redo are exact, and survive F5
why: On a copy: 16 mixed edits (razor, Q/W/[ ] trims, Ctrl+D / Shift+D / Ctrl+Shift+D, ripple deletes, cut/copy/paste, duplicate) with an F5 in the middle; then 7 more edits, 4 undos, F5 (↶/↷ tooltips still 'undo: Cross Dissolve' / 'redo: split'), the rest undone = exactly the starting cut, all 7 redone = exactly the finished cut (checked shot by shot against the server). Every step's tooltip names it.

title: A title I can actually adjust by hand
why: The AI title came back in ~25 s, centred in the lower third, '✓ checked · inside the frame'; 'edit by hand' gives words, size, x/y with nudge arrows, in and 'for', a title-safe guide on the Program, 'no model call'; one Accept put it in the cut with an undo step named after it.

title: Export is honest and quick
why: Export dialog says exactly what sound it writes (AAC 192k, -1 dBTP, no loudness normalising) and that later edits aren't in the file; 'Keep working' exists; 82 s at 1080p took ~45 s; the file is 81.9 s, 1920x1080 23.976, peak -1.9 dB, both titles and the grade are in it.
